title: Llamafile Builder Versions Registry
description: Schema for versions.json - defines available llamafile runtime versions

VersionGroup.description: A group of related llamafile releases (e.g., all 0.9.x versions)

name.description: Display name for the version group (e.g., 'llamafile 0.9', 'llamafile 0.10')

tag.description: Release channel tag. 'latest' for newest features, 'stable' for production-ready, 'legacy' for older versions.

description.description: Brief description of this version group's features. Supports markdown links.

releases.description: Individual releases within this version group, ordered newest first

description.description: Brief description of this release's changes. Supports markdown links to release notes.

download_url.description: Direct download URL for the llamafile binary

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file for integrity verification
